messages:
ayan (PM): quick check-in on the autoscale controls designs. main goals: make guardrails visible earlier, clarify burst billing, and keep keyboard-first interactions solid. landing Friday?

felix (Product Designer): sharing two patterns: 1) inline validation + subtle motion when user tries invalid min/max; 2) explicit guardrail summary row under advanced settings with reasons for forced values. sketch in Figma soon.

julia (Frontend): +1 on explicit summary row. for inline motion, prefer a short transform (scaleY 0.98) and aria-live update rather than long keyframe shakes. also recommend debounce on slider to avoid spammy updates.

kai (A11y): please add prefers-reduced-motion support. all error text must appear in an ARIA live region and color shouldn't be the only clue. also keyboard users need clear focus states on min/max inputs and the SLO slider handle (outline + visible numeric tooltip on focus).

noor (UX Research): in tests people didn't associate "burst" with billing. propose this microcopy: "Burst: temporarily allocate extra GPUs for spikes. Billed separately — see pricing." put a small info icon that opens a tiny modal with examples: 5m spike vs sustained increase.

felix (Product Designer): for the SLO slider, thinking to surface an inline estimated cost delta badge while dragging: small chip right of slider that says "~+9% cost". we should display both relative and absolute: "~+9% (~$120/mo)". question: is backend data available to make that estimate?

julia (Frontend): backend can expose coarse unit-costs per pool. we can compute estimate client-side with a simple formula. will need to cache values and throttle calls. implement a /pricing/estimate?poolId=... endpoint that returns baseUnitCost and a short TTL. debounce slider events to 250ms.

kai (A11y): cost chip must have aria-label: "Estimated cost increase nine percent, about one hundred twenty dollars per month" and should not rely on color. include small icon + text.

ayan (PM): another product edge: when a guardrail forces the min up, customers ask why. can we show an explanation pill: "Adjusted to meet p95 200ms" with a link to a timeline or logs?

felix (Product Designer): yes — design a low-contrast pill under the controls: copy "Min adjusted to 4 to meet p95 SLO (200ms)." with a chevron to expand rollout details. collapsed state shows brief reason, expanded shows timeline and a link to audit logs.

julia (Frontend): implement with an expandable region; important: keep it keyboard accessible and ensure the expand/collapse state is announced to screen readers. also add a persistent id for each banner so we don't show the same message repeatedly.

noor (UX Research): testers liked the expandable context. they want an explicit "Dismiss" that acknowledges the change, not a silent hide. also ask: any plan to surface historical adjustments in the Console? users want a short history (last 7 events).

ayan (PM): product prefers inline 7-event history in the expanded panel and a link to full rollout logs. felix, can you add that to the frame?

felix (Product Designer): will do. I'll add reduced-motion flows, tooltip strings, and the microcopy variants: short, medium, and long. uploading to Figma in ~2h and will ping thread. :rocket:

ci-bot: integration tests for feature/autoscale-ui scheduled, target branch: staging, ETA: 2026-03-24T04:00:00Z.

ayan (PM): great. action items: felix -> Figma frames + copy variants + a11y notes; julia -> pricing endpoint contract and debounce plan; kai -> review final frames for contrast and live region wording; noor -> recruit 3 follow-ups for cost-estimate mental model. deadline: Friday EOD. thanks!
